entries.wording: 仓库处理中 - 分拣打包中 / Packaging at munich
entries.note: The firm's warehouse in Germany sorts and packs the goods: the first row in its hands.

entries.wording: 快递已揽收 - 已打包完成交付快递 / Packaged and delivered express
entries.note: Packed and handed to the courier that takes it to the airport.

entries.wording: 货物已发往机场 - 货物已发往机场 / To the Airport
entries.note: On its way to the airport.

entries.wording: 货物已到达机场 - 货物已到达机场，等待起飞 / Deliver to the Airport, Awaiting Departure
entries.note: At the airport, waiting for its flight.

entries.wording: 航班已起飞 - 货物已发往中国 / Deliver to China
已抵达 - 货物抵达中国 / Arrive in China
清关中 - 包裹清关中，请耐心等待
entries.note: Import clearance in China; the domestic courier takes over after it, in rows the page asks a relay for.
